blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: concurrency — Multiple tasks make progress in overlapping period.
race condition — Incorrect timing-dependent shared state.

blocks.title: Identify
blocks.text: Find tasks that do not depend on each other's intermediate results. Independent work can overlap.

blocks.title: Model
blocks.text: Distinguish concurrency (progress interleaved) from parallelism (truly simultaneous hardware execution).

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Evaluate scheduling overhead and shared-resource/race risks, and explain why dependencies limit possible speedup.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the decision
blocks.text: Only independent tasks can safely overlap without waiting for each other.
